item.title: Willis hopeful ahead of Challenge Vase semi-final clash
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis is hopeful of clinching Birmingham FA Women’s Challenge Vase glory this season, as the Saddlers face Redditch United Women away from home on Sunday afternoon. The upcoming semi-final clash against the Reds could see Walsall make the final of the competition for the second season running and Willis admits he wants to bring the trophy to the Black Country. item.title: Match Report: Redditch United 2-3 Walsall Women
item.description: Walsall Women progressed to the Birmingham FA Women’s Challenge Vase final with a dramatic 3-2 win over Redditch United Women at The Valley Stadium. Molly Cook netted a well-taken brace in the first half, with Ellie Williams’ double keeping the sides level until late on. However, Mia Fellows set the Saddlers up for their first chance of silverware this season after 85 minutes with a simple finish. item.title: Willis proud of resilience in semi-final triumph
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis was massively proud of his side’s resilience in their 3-2 away win over Redditch United at The Valley Stadium. item.title: Match Report: Grimsby Town 2-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall walked away with a hard-earned point after a 2-2 draw at Blundell Park in Sky Bet League Two action tonight.
